meaning.en: Third-person singular simple present indicative form of marker.

meaning_vi: người ghi số điểm (trong trò chơi bi a)
pháo sáng (để soi mục tiêu cho những cuộc ném bom đêm)

sentences.en: She slung the markers designating her as the Undersecretary's assistant against the wall then crushed them with the heel of her boot.

sentences.en: These markers included vimentin, desmin, smooth muscle actin and myosin.

sentences.en: The linguistic characteristics of natural argumentation, including discourse markers, sentence format, referring expressions, and style.

sentences.en: Sixty minute markers printed on angled fixed internal bezel giving a three dimensional effect to the dial.

sentences.en: Shown on the right is a set of heritage walk markers in embossed solid brass.
